muzik/b5_donusum.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Intense horror transformation underscore, 14 seconds: starts with a low trembling sub-bass drone and dissonant high string clusters, quickly builds with pounding deep taiko-like hits and screeching aleatoric strings, metallic scrapes, rising brass growl, peaks in a terrifying wall of sound at around 10 seconds, then holds a sustained menacing chord. No melody, no vocals, cinematic monster reveal.

muzik/b5_donusum_tam.desc: B5 dönüşüm altyapısı: muzik/b5_donusum (ElevenLabs Music) 0-13 sn + efekt/korku_drone (kendi sentezimiz) yükselen bölüm; 17.18 sn'de kükremeyle keskin kesilir, sonrası sessiz. -18 LUFS.

muzik/b6_safak.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Original instrumental film score cue for the quiet morning after a night of terror: sad yet peaceful, tender and healing. Solo soft felt piano with warm sustained string ensemble, slow tempo around 60 bpm, B minor resolving to D major. Opens very sparse and fragile with single piano notes over a soft string drone, gradually adds cello and violins, swells gently into an emotional warm climax around 26 to 36 seconds with full sustained strings and rich piano chords, then settles into a calm, hopeful, quiet resolution and soft fade. No vocals, no percussion, no drums, intimate and cinematic.

muzik/banyo_komik.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Playful light comedic morning underscore for a Turkish web series, pizzicato strings, soft marimba and light claps, cheeky and bouncy, warm, no vocals, ends with a brief slightly ominous low note

muzik/cliffhanger.desc: Bölüm sonu: 5 sn yükselen gerilim + darbe. Sır açığa çıkmadan kesme.

muzik/deli_tema.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Psychological thriller theme for a Turkish series about a man who may or may not be insane, detuned music box melody over a dark low string drone, sparse prepared piano notes, unsettling, slowly building tension, no vocals

muzik/dram_huzun.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Heartbreaking slow solo piano with soft string pad, grief and loss, very emotional Turkish drama theme, sparse notes, builds gently, no vocals

muzik/dram_yolculuk.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Warm nostalgic Turkish family road trip underscore, gentle acoustic guitar and soft baglama, light hand percussion, happy and tender, everyday joy, no vocals

muzik/gerilim.desc: Gerilim yatağı: düşük drone + nabız gibi bas + tiz disonans. Sırlar, tehdit.

muzik/gizem.desc: Gizem: müzik kutusu/çelesta melodisi + karanlık pad. Geçmiş, sır, flashback.

muzik/hafif_komik.desc: Hafif/komik: pizzicato hissi, 104 bpm. Çocuklar, günlük hayat, mizah.

muzik/huzunlu_piyano.desc: Hüzünlü piyano (La minör, 66 bpm). Ayrılık, kayıp, iç ses.

muzik/jenerik_tema.desc: Dizinin ana teması (leitmotif). Açılış/kapanış jeneriği, 9 notalık motif.

muzik/kat7_gerilim.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Dark cinematic horror underscore for a night security guard alone in an old building. Slow, sparse and unsettling: deep sub-bass drone, a faint heartbeat-like low pulse, dissonant high sustained strings that slowly swell, occasional distant metallic scrapes and reversed piano notes. No melody, no drums, no vocals. Builds tension very gradually, never resolves.

muzik/kayip_ada.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Emotional cinematic underscore for a castaway CEO on a remote Indian Ocean island, soft hand drums, distant wooden flute, warm strings, mystery and melancholy, slowly building, no vocals

muzik/market_gerilim.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Minimal eerie horror score for an empty 24-hour convenience store at 3 a.m. Cold buzzing synth pad like fluorescent lights, a slow detuned music-box motif that repeats and slightly warps, soft sub-bass pulses, sparse high glassy tones, occasional unsettling silence. No drums, no vocals, no melody resolution. Creepy, lonely, tense, slowly building dread.

muzik/market_tedirgin.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Quiet uneasy underscore for a night convenience store scene in a Turkish mystery series, soft muted electric piano and warm synth pad, gentle pulse, friendly on the surface but something feels slightly off, subtle dissonant notes, no vocals, minimal, slow

muzik/romantik.desc: Romantik: yavaş maj7 piyano. Bakışmalar, itiraf.

muzik/umut.desc: Umut / sıcaklık: majör akorlar, yumuşak pad ve piyano. Barışma, kavuşma.
